moments.selftext: A cave in Bulgaria has earned the nickname “the Eyes of God” because of its striking natural formations. Deep within Bulgaria’s karst landscape lies Prohodna Cave, known for its two enormous, symmetrical openings in the ceiling. Resembling a pair of eyes, they have earned the cave the nickname “The Eyes of God.” During the day, sunlight streams through the natural skylights, while at night, they can frame the moon and stars above. The unusual geological formation creates a striking atmosphere that continues to draw visitors today.
